description: Match Lore: press conference. WHEN: get the full #779 press-conference write-up for a FINISHED match — headline, dramatic recap naming the turning point, winner + loser quotes, and a stats footer (final score, events, lead changes, notable moments) as markdown, plus the #763 tabloid recap from match_lore_get's generator. Deterministic and idempotent by match_id (same match -> same document; generated once, then served from the lore_conferences cache). No auth required, 0 credits. Differs from match_lore_get (tabloid payload only, no stats footer / lead changes / markdown document) and arena_get_replay (tick diffs). Optionally pass log:{.} — a match event log in the core schema (match_id, game, players, ordered events with scores, winner, notable_moments) — to generate from a log in hand instead of the stored match. Example: lore_press_conference {"match_id":"<match_id>"}

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

log.description: Optional event log in the #779 core schema; when present it is used instead of reading the matches table.

match_id.description: Finished match ID to write up.

name: lore_press_conference
title: Match Lore: post-match press conference
